in_marathi.name: Omveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Omveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Omveer is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘om’ meaning ‘supreme being’ and ‘veer’ meaning ‘hero’ or ‘brave’. This name signifies the protector and ruler of the universe, often used to honor a deity or a brave warrior.
